design: Fresh random dictionary, coordinate encoder, membership and energy detector. Four oracle-information conditions:both membership/gates supplied, membership only,gates only,neither. For unknown gates train exact Bernoulli expected cost over16patterns; unknown membership uses hardTop3 ST. Same three seeds/minibatches. Select hard validation reconstruction+count cost every100steps, held combinations afterward. Joint condition never uses generating labels in optimization/selection.
limitations: One noiseless teacher,known latent/group sizes and3members pergroup,small exactenumeration,hardmembership surrogate. Effective trained parameters differ across oracleconditions. Fixed membership costs constant; no learned membershipbudget.
